As a reminder, the family would like a small lakeside memorial, and I'm currently holding the ashes. I know the lake park has a north paved trail leading to Willow Point and a steeper south path to a different shoreline area. Before I settle on specifics like place, timing, ceremony materials, and the dedication, I want to make sure we hear everyone's needs and any relevant updates. The gathering will be brief, with the ashes placed in the water during the ceremony. Please go ahead and share anything you think I should know.
